en.name: radres/call-me

Remote endpoint: `https://callmemcp.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no auth). Ringing a phone needs the Call Me iOS app, paired by the 10-digit number it shows. Clients: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cline, ChatGPT, claude.ai. Official MCP Registry id `com.callmemcp/call-me`. Website: https://callmemcp.com. MIT.

abilities.name: Salesforce 智能 (io.github.PranavNagrecha/salesforce-intelligence)
abilities.description: 在对 Salesforce 进行更改前，向 AI 询问可能引发的故障。通过一次性提取 Salesforce 组织的元数据构建本地知识库与依赖图谱，并在离线、只读状态下解答关于影响面、字段使用率、自动化流程、权限及 Apex 相关的疑问，且答案均附带元数据依据。无需登录 Salesforce 即可体验：`npx -y sf-intelligence demo`。在自有组织中使用：`npx -y sf-intelligence mcp --vault /absolute/path/to/org-kb`。传输协议：stdio。认证方式：服务端免认证（构建知识库时直接复用现有的 Salesforce CLI 登录态）。官方 MCP 注册表 ID：`io.github.PranavNagrecha/salesforce-intelligence`。遵循附加 Commons Clause 的 MIT 协议（源码可用）。[文档](https://sfi.auditforce.cloud)。

zh.name: Salesforce 智能 (io.github.PranavNagrecha/salesforce-intelligence)
zh.description: 在对 Salesforce 进行更改前，向 AI 询问可能引发的故障。通过一次性提取 Salesforce 组织的元数据构建本地知识库与依赖图谱，并在离线、只读状态下解答关于影响面、字段使用率、自动化流程、权限及 Apex 相关的疑问，且答案均附带元数据依据。无需登录 Salesforce 即可体验：`npx -y sf-intelligence demo`。在自有组织中使用：`npx -y sf-intelligence mcp --vault /absolute/path/to/org-kb`。传输协议：stdio。认证方式：服务端免认证（构建知识库时直接复用现有的 Salesforce CLI 登录态）。官方 MCP 注册表 ID：`io.github.PranavNagrecha/salesforce-intelligence`。遵循附加 Commons Clause 的 MIT 协议（源码可用）。[文档](https://sfi.auditforce.cloud)。

en.name: Salesforce Intelligence (io.github.PranavNagrecha/salesforce-intelligence)
en.description: Ask your AI what breaks before you change Salesforce. Builds a local vault and dependency graph from one retrieve of a Salesforce org's metadata, then answers impact, field-usage, automation, permission and Apex questions offline and read-only, citing the metadata behind each answer. Try it without a Salesforce login: `npx -y sf-intelligence demo`. Own org: `npx -y sf-intelligence mcp --vault /absolute/path/to/org-kb`. Transport: stdio. Auth: none for the server (building a vault uses your existing Salesforce CLI login). Official MCP Registry id `io.github.PranavNagrecha/salesforce-intelligence`. License: MIT with Commons Clause (source-available). [Docs](https://sfi.auditforce.cloud).

abilities.name: shibley/apistatuscheck-mcp-server
abilities.description: 提供涵盖 30 个分类的 285 个公共 API 和开发者平台的实时与历史可用性，用于区分第三方故障还是调用方自身代码中的 Bug。`get_api_status` 会在调用时探测端点，并将其与每小时监控数值及时间戳一同返回，因此单区域波动会表现为状态不一致，而非直接报告为故障。采用 Streamable HTTP，无状态、只读且免鉴权：`https://apistatuscheck.com/api/mcp`。提供工具：`list_apis`、`search_apis`、`get_api_status`、`list_down_apis`、`get_uptime_history`、`list_categories`。注册表 ID：`io.github.shibley/apistatuscheck`。注：`GET` 会返回 405（无状态 Serverless，不保持常开 SSE 流）；支持基于 POST 的客户端。

en.name: shibley/apistatuscheck-mcp-server

abilities.name: Shinjuku Shielded MCP
abilities.description: Solana 上的隐私 x402 支付：支持屏蔽（shield）USDC、从自托管屏蔽余额支付 x402 链接（链上不显示付款人），以及在用户自行设定的支出限额下解除屏蔽（unshield）。包含 7 种工具：`x402_preview`（未支付请求：价格、方案、限额检查）、`x402_pay`（别名 `fetch_paid`）、`wallet_balance`、`wallet_receipts`、`wallet_cancel`、`wallet_shield` 和 `wallet_unshield`（新目标地址需通过 MCP 交互确认）。内置 Tor；无需 RPC、账户或 API 密钥。安装命令：`npx -y shinjuku-shielded mcp --max-payment 50000 --max-session 200000`；走 stdio 传输，在 Node.js 22+ 本地运行。环境变量：`SHIELDED_WALLET_HOME`（加密钱包目录）、`SHIELDED_WALLET_PASSPHRASE`（密钥）或 `--passphrase-file`。屏蔽与解除屏蔽证明工具仅支持 Linux 或 WSL。官方 MCP 注册表 ID：`io.github.ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-mcp`。文档：https://github.com/ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-shielded。网站：https://shinjukustaition.com。

en.name: Shinjuku Shielded MCP
en.description: Private x402 payments on Solana: shield USDC, pay x402 URLs from a self-custodied shielded balance (the chain does not show who paid), and unshield, under spend caps that only the user sets. Seven tools: `x402_preview` (unpaid request: price, scheme, cap check), `x402_pay` (alias `fetch_paid`), `wallet_balance`, `wallet_receipts`, `wallet_cancel`, `wallet_shield` and `wallet_unshield` (a new destination address needs the user's confirmation through MCP elicitation). Tor built in; no RPC, account or API key needed. Install: `npx -y shinjuku-shielded mcp --max-payment 50000 --max-session 200000`; stdio, runs locally on Node.js 22+. Env: `SHIELDED_WALLET_HOME` (folder with the encrypted wallet), `SHIELDED_WALLET_PASSPHRASE` (secret) or `--passphrase-file`. Shield and unshield proof tools run on Linux or WSL only. Official MCP Registry id `io.github.ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-mcp`. Docs: https://github.com/ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-shielded. Website: https://shinjukustaition.com.

Covers social listening and content analysis across X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest and Xiaohongshu; website and competitor intelligence including traffic estimates, traffic-source breakdowns, top pages, keyword research and SEO analysis; and lead and creator (KOL/KOC) discovery. Hosted only: Streamable HTTP at `https://connector.springbrand.ai/mcp`; OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE (S256), no API key. abilities.name: Srinivasan-78/repo2graph
abilities.description: 使用 tree-sitter 将代码仓库解析为由文件、函数、调用、导入和继承关系构成的图谱，再通过 BM25 种子检索结合图展开来回答问题。返回的每个代码块均带有形如 `[cite: path:start-end]` 的标头，并附带该符号的调用方与被调用方。`--git-history` 可为经常一同变更的文件添加 CO_CHANGE 边（这是仅靠 AST 无法捕捉的）。提供 5 个工具：`repo_map`、`repo_search`、`repo_neighbours`、`repo_cache_stats`、`repo_build_status`。首次调用时自动索引仓库，无需前置配置；输出硬性限制在 12k tokens 以内，且绝不返回疑似凭据的路径。无需调用 LLM，亦无网络访问。安装：`uvx --from "repo2graph[mcp]" repo2graph-mcp /path/to/project`。开源协议：MIT。

zh.description: 使用 tree-sitter 将代码仓库解析为由文件、函数、调用、导入和继承关系构成的图谱，再通过 BM25 种子检索结合图展开来回答问题。返回的每个代码块均带有形如 `[cite: path:start-end]` 的标头，并附带该符号的调用方与被调用方。`--git-history` 可为经常一同变更的文件添加 CO_CHANGE 边（这是仅靠 AST 无法捕捉的）。提供 5 个工具：`repo_map`、`repo_search`、`repo_neighbours`、`repo_cache_stats`、`repo_build_status`。首次调用时自动索引仓库，无需前置配置；输出硬性限制在 12k tokens 以内，且绝不返回疑似凭据的路径。无需调用 LLM，亦无网络访问。安装：`uvx --from "repo2graph[mcp]" repo2graph-mcp /path/to/project`。开源协议：MIT。

en.name: Srinivasan-78/repo2graph
en.description: Parses a repository with tree-sitter into a graph of files, functions, calls, imports and inheritance, then answers questions from it with BM25 seeds plus graph expansion, so every block returned is headed `[cite: path:start-end]` with that symbol's callers and callees attached. `--git-history` adds CO_CHANGE edges for files that keep changing together, which no AST alone can see. Five tools: `repo_map`, `repo_search`, `repo_neighbours`, `repo_cache_stats`, `repo_build_status`. It indexes the repository on the first call, so there is no setup step; output is hard-capped at 12k tokens and credential-looking paths are never returned. No LLM call and no network access. Install: `uvx --from "repo2graph[mcp]" repo2graph-mcp /path/to/project`. MIT.

en.name: stcmain/whats-allowed-mcp
en.description: Shows what your coding agent can do without asking you. Reads every settings file that contributes permission rules — managed policy, project, git-ignored local, user — and reports the merged result with provenance: which file each rule came from, which `defaultMode` wins, what proceeds unattended (blanket allows, additional directories, hook commands), and which rules the client accepts and then ignores (path rules on `Write`/`Glob`, `param:value` rules on a tool's primary content field, unanchored allow globs, `/path` rules in user settings that anchor at the config directory instead of your project, allow rules a deny or ask rule reaches first). Each finding links to the documented behaviour it comes from; there is no risk score and no simulated verdict for a hypothetical command. Four read-only tools; no child processes, no network, no writes, and `env` entries are read by name only. Install: `npx -y whats-allowed-mcp`. Registry id `io.github.stcmain/whats-allowed-mcp`. MIT.

abilities.name: stcmain/whats-inherited-mcp

en.name: stcmain/whats-inherited-mcp
en.description: Shows what a checkout tells your agent to do before you run it — instruction files (`CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` and the files their imports pull in), commands wired to run automatically via hooks or settings, MCP servers the repo declares, and skills/commands/subagents it ships under `.claude/` or `.agents/` (root or nested, as monorepos use). Useful before running an unfamiliar repo or reviewing a dependency. Quoted strings are returned clearly marked as data, not instructions. Five read-only tools; no child processes, no network, no file writes, and env vars are read by name only. Install: `npx -y whats-inherited-mcp`. Registry id `io.github.stcmain/whats-inherited-mcp`. MIT.

Counts only what actually loads: skill bodies, disabled plugins and stale plugin-cache versions are excluded, and token figures are labelled as estimates. Five read-only tools; no child processes, no network, no path built from model input. Install: `npx -y whats-loaded-mcp`. Registry id `io.github.stcmain/whats-loaded-mcp`. MIT.

en.name: stipend
en.description: Non-custodial USDC wallet on Base that an AI agent installs by itself. Per-transaction, per-day and per-counterparty caps plus a destination allowlist are enforced in code between the decision and the signature, so no instruction in the context window can raise them; the first payment to an address never paid before needs confirming whatever the size. Local stdio, 7 tools: `stipend_address`, `stipend_balance`, `stipend_check`, `stipend_pay`, `stipend_earnings`, `stipend_report`, `stipend_recover`. No tool reads, exports or derives the private key, and none changes a limit. Deliberately not hosted. In the official MCP Registry as `io.github.Graphiker-Australia/stipend`. Install: `pip install eth-account && curl -sL stipend.sh/install | sh`, then `stipend mcp`. Python, Apache-2.0. Not audited.

abilities.name: techreone/xknow-mcp
abilities.description: XKnow 知识库的本地 MCP 服务器——提供精选且相互关联的 SEO、SaaS 与 LLM-wiki 知识体系。包含六个只读工具：带排名的 `search_knowledge`、获取笔记全文的 `get_page`、基于图谱的 `explore_concept`（笔记及其出链和反向链接）、`list_topics`、`lint_rules`（附带优先级与修复方案的书面内容自检规范），以及用于标准引用元数据的 `cite`，以便回答时注明来源。无网络请求、无遥测数据、无需 API 密钥：免费版预装了 57 篇公开指南的静态快照，通过 `--vault` 可指定购买的 500 多篇笔记库（数据始终保留在本地）。安装命令：`npx -y xknow-mcp`。通信协议：`stdio`；免认证；支持 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Cline、opencode 及兼容的 MCP 客户端；遵循 MIT 协议。网址：https://xknow.org/mcp。官方注册表 ID：`io.github.techreone/xknow-mcp`。

zh.name: techreone/xknow-mcp
zh.description: XKnow 知识库的本地 MCP 服务器——提供精选且相互关联的 SEO、SaaS 与 LLM-wiki 知识体系。包含六个只读工具：带排名的 `search_knowledge`、获取笔记全文的 `get_page`、基于图谱的 `explore_concept`（笔记及其出链和反向链接）、`list_topics`、`lint_rules`（附带优先级与修复方案的书面内容自检规范），以及用于标准引用元数据的 `cite`，以便回答时注明来源。无网络请求、无遥测数据、无需 API 密钥：免费版预装了 57 篇公开指南的静态快照，通过 `--vault` 可指定购买的 500 多篇笔记库（数据始终保留在本地）。安装命令：`npx -y xknow-mcp`。通信协议：`stdio`；免认证；支持 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Cline、opencode 及兼容的 MCP 客户端；遵循 MIT 协议。网址：https://xknow.org/mcp。官方注册表 ID：`io.github.techreone/xknow-mcp`。

en.name: techreone/xknow-mcp
en.description: Local MCP server for the XKnow knowledge base — a curated, cross-linked body of SEO, SaaS, and LLM-wiki knowledge. Six read-only tools: ranked `search_knowledge`, `get_page` for full note text, graph-aware `explore_concept` (a note plus its outbound links and backlinks), `list_topics`, `lint_rules` (a written-content self-check rubric with priorities and fixes), and `cite` for canonical citation metadata so answers can attribute the source. No network calls, no telemetry, no API key: the free layer bundles a static snapshot of 57 public guides, and `--vault` points it at a purchased 500+ note vault that never leaves the machine. Install: `npx -y xknow-mcp`. Transport: `stdio`; no auth; clients: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, opencode, and compatible MCP clients; MIT. Site: https://xknow.org/mcp. Official Registry: `io.github.techreone/xknow-mcp`.
